annotations.title: Get attribution, install and KPI reporting

description: Where installs and revenue came from, on the same definitions as the dashboard and the API. An install is a device's first SDK launch (install_at) in the range; server-only users are never installs. Non-organic = installs with an attribution that is exact (store referrer, Apple Ads, claimed or opened link, clipboard, code, product page, ad id), weak (UTM only) or modelled (Android/web IP match within 60 minutes; never iOS), not retargeting and not fraud-flagged; organic = installs − non_organic − fraud_flagged. Installs from test sources are left out (count in test_installs) unless include_test is true. `summary`: totals, exact_installs / weak_installs / modelled_installs, exact_match_rate, fraud_flagged, reinstalls, CVR (installs whose winning touch is a /l click ÷ unique non-bot /l clicks), weighted D1/D7 retention, revenue by PAYMENT date (`revenue`, per currency), by_platform, rules_changed_at (when the current counting rules began; numbers before it were counted under the old rules and are not recomputed) and time_zone. `kpis`: the same split per source / campaign / link / day / platform, with spend, cohort revenue (paid in the range by installs from the range) and ROAS = net cohort revenue ÷ spend; revenue_by_payment_date is the separate payment-date figure. `installs`: individual installs with match_type, match_kind, confidence, fraud_rule and is_reinstall. `accuracy`: exact-match rate by day, platform and link, and how often a modelled guess was later replaced by an exact match. Money is micros in the currency named beside it; never add amounts of different currencies. Default range: the last 28 days (until − 27 days through today) in the app's time zone.

include_test.description: Keep installs from test sources (default false)

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, last day (default: today in the app's time zone)
